code.inputs: Exact repository, head, base and CI/runtime environment
code.checks: Changed behavior, regressions and relevant tests
code.failure_modes: Green producer logs or wrong PR head
code.stop: Missing safe runtime or immutable revision

ui.inputs: Exact URL, deployment, named viewport contract
ui.checks: Layout, responsive states, overflow; HTTP/console/network when relevant
ui.stop: Unsafe page or no current capture
ui.pass_permits: Review of this deployment and viewports

interaction.inputs: Bound application and safe ordered workflow
interaction.checks: Ordered steps, error paths and resulting state
interaction.stop: No safe trace or recording surface

document.inputs: Source hash, rendered revision and page contract
document.checks: Content, citations, links, pagination and clipping

data.inputs: Dataset hashes, range, schema, units and filters
data.checks: Counts, completeness, formulas, nulls, joins and totals
data.stop: Missing source or permitted data surface
data.pass_permits: Review of this dataset and calculations

operations.inputs: Service identity, environment, config hash and expected state
operations.checks: Persisted state, supported reads and safe dry runs
operations.failure_modes: UI implies state that was never persisted
operations.pass_permits: Review of the observed state only

decision.inputs: Review content, evidence snapshot and proposed action fingerprints
decision.checks: Provenance, recalculation, assumptions, counterevidence and reversibility
decision.failure_modes: Confident claims from incomplete or stale sources
decision.stop: Missing material evidence or decision threshold
decision.pass_permits: Decision-ready for human review; no action authorized

process.inputs: Process commit, package/config hashes and exact evaluation corpus
process.checks: False passes/blocks, separation, stale results, media, privacy and rework
process.failure_modes: Instruction keywords mistaken for process behavior
process.stop: Fresh verifier or executable cases unavailable
process.pass_permits: Review of this process version and evaluated cases only
